replications.journal: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science
replications.quote: This result does not support the hypothesis that sales estimates are influenced by incidental anchors. The effect size was in the same direction as the original effect size, but much smaller (d = 0.04, 95% CI = [−0.01, 0.09], vs. original d = 0.30) and indistinguishable from zero.
